evidence.scope: Static registration, unlock comparison, ordered first-status-3 selection, territory/status update and strategic-world dispatch into reserve selector. Does not establish full save/load or rendered behavior.
evidence.turn_counter: Reserve selector compares global strategic +0x68 directly. Getter 0xbbc110 returns the same field with no offset; integer condition evaluator 0x6f2dc0 forwards it to its comparison operator. Global initialization sets it to zero at 0xbb84a0 before strategic startup. Exact rendered turn origin still belongs to final manual acceptance; no speculative +1/-1 conversion is applied.
evidence.registration: SetPossibleSpawnPositions replaces coalition group vector; register all divisions together. AddPossibleProduction copies unlock value into reserve record.
evidence.selection: 0xd17350 compares current turn at strategic global +0x68 against record +0x40, skips locked records, resolves division, selects first position with status 3; null selection skips placement.
evidence.availability: 0xbca950 iterates positions in reverse priority order. r13 starts true; current status is 3 without nearby hostiles, 2 with nearby hostiles, or 1 when current territory or the lower-priority suffix is invalid. r13 accumulates friendly territory AND no nearby hostiles. Thus an unsafe rear blocks the front; a captured front does not invalidate an already safe rear. 0x879700 resolves influence polygon and coalition relationship.
evidence.dispatch: Strategic world 0xbd4750 tailcalls controller 0xd2bfd0 at 0xbd492d. Controller selects current side from strategic global +0x70, checks side component byte +0x18 through 0xd18fc0/0x26df60, then calls 0x5d1c00 with embedded reserve component +0x30 at 0xd2c0c9. Generic dispatch jumps vtable +0x18; reserve vtable 0x237f628 +0x18 points to 0xd17350. There is no NATO/PACT constant in this gate; interpretation of the side flag as AI still requires type evidence.
